newsitem.title: USA: Most U.S. debt futures rally on U.S. data.
newsitem.headline: Most U.S. debt futures rally on U.S. data.

text.p: July 1 - Most U.S. debt futures rallied on U.S. June NAPM data. NAPM fell to 55.7, from est of 56.4 and against May's 57.1. New orders also fell from May. U.S. May construction spending dropped 1.8 pct, vs forecasts for a 0.5-pct rise. Sept T-bonds rose to 111-14/32, above the pivot at 111-05/32. (Chicago Derivatives Desk(312)408-8750))
